jobs.title: Blue Yonder WMS Specialist (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Mehr als ein Job

In unserem Kontraktlogistikteam verantwortest du Lagerhaltungsvorgänge - sei es z.B. durch die Kommissionierung von Waren im Lager oder durch organisatorische Tätigkeiten im Büro. Dabei arbeitest du präzise und trägst damit nicht nur zum Erfolg deines Teams bei, sondern sorgst auch für ein reibungsloses Tagesgeschäft in unseren Lager- und Distributionszentren. Mit deiner Arbeit ermöglichst du z. B. die Lagerung und Lieferung von Ersatzteilen diverser Industrien oder von medizinischen Produkten. Dabei bewirkst du mit deiner Arbeit bei Kühne+Nagel viel mehr, als du dir vorstellen kannst.

‎
Join our National Information Systems Expert Team in Switzerland as a Blue Yonder WMS Specialist (m/w/d) and help shape the future of logistics.
You will work on diverse projects across multiple sites, supporting warehouse operations and distribution for leading global customers.
In this role, you act as the critical link between operations and IT – transforming logistics needs into smart system solutions. Your expertise will drive continuous improvement, ensure system availability, and enhance overall operational performance.

Wie du dich einbringst

  • As a point of contact for our customer and operations, you’ll handle system-related inquiries and provide first-level support, including creating next-level tickets.
  • Your responsibility includes ensuring optimal functionality of our Blue Yonder (JDA) Warehouse Management and Transportation systems.
  • You’ll be involved in implementing projects within the system environment of our Warehouse and Transport Management Systems, including integrating external service providers and applications.
  • Analyze and optimize work/process flows related to the deployed systems, and contribute to process and solution design.
  • Customize the Data Warehouse and create reports.
  • Prepare and conduct user training and workshops.
  • Perform regression and new development testing.
  • Maintain online documentation of system processes, keeping it up-to-date.

Was dich auszeichnet

  • Advanced configuration knowledge of Blue Yonder WMS (JDA Discrete).
  • Professional background in warehousing or contract logistics.
  • Demonstrated problem-solving abilities, a strong customer service orientation, and a collaborative team spirit.
  • Proficient in analytical thinking, with a self-directed and structured work approach.
  • Effective English communication skills;
  • Knowledge of SQL and Moca.
  • 1st Level Support Experience

Was für dich drin ist

At Kühne + Nagel, you are always part of a dedicated and dynamic team because great achievements can only happen together. Join us on our journey with the vision of enhancing our innovative logistics solutions even further. • We offer genuine professional and personal growth opportunities in a secure work environment. Our employees value the high degree of autonomy, rapid delegation of responsibilities, and the availability of regular training and development programs. Success hinges on the people who make it possible, which is why we strive to have you on board for the long term.

Wer wir sind

Logistik berührt jeden Aspekt unseres Lebens – von den Gütern, die wir täglich konsumieren bis zur Gesundheitsversorgung, auf die wir uns verlassen. Bei uns geht deine Arbeit über Logistik hinaus: Sie ermöglicht die kleinen und großen Momente des Lebens für Menschen auf der ganzen Welt.

Als ein global führendes Logistikunternehmen mit der Vision, unsere Welt weiterzuentwickeln, bieten wir dir ein sicheres und stabiles Umfeld. Hier macht deine Arbeit einen echten Unterschied. Ob die Lieferung von Lebensmitteln, die Entwicklung nachhaltiger Transportlösungen oder gesellschaftliches Engagement – deine Arbeit bewirkt mehr, als du dir vorstellen kannst.

jobs.description:
It's more than a job

At Kuehne+Nagel, a career in Corporate Communications means advacing the company's communications strategies, but it's also something more. Thank to your work, you strengthen the company's reputation, at the pulse of global trade.

‎

Are you passionate about storytelling, stakeholder engagement, and shaping communications that make an impact on a global scale? As a Communications Manager Technology, you will support the development and execution of internal and external communication activities for our Tech division. Working closely with senior leaders and communications professionals across the organization, you will help bring key technology messages to life, strengthen employee engagement, and enhance our visibility across international markets.

How you create impact

  • Develop and execute internal communication initiatives that connect employees with business priorities, vision, and strategy.
  • Create engaging content across multiple communication channels, translating complex business topics into compelling stories.
  • Manage and maintain the divisional intranet presence, ensuring relevant, timely, and impactful communications.
  • Support internal engagement activities and events, including townhalls, change initiatives, and transformation programmes.
  • Build and maintain relationships with media representatives and support global media relations activities.
  • Contribute to the creation of external communication materials, including press releases, thought leadership content, newsletters, and social media communications.
  • Partner with IT, Marketing, HR, Sales and business leaders to ensure consistent messaging and brand alignment.
  • Monitor industry trends, support reputation management initiatives, and contribute to crisis communication activities when required.

What we would like you to bring

  • 7-10 years of experience in corporate communications, public relations, media relations, or a related field.
  • Proven experience managing both internal and external communication activities in a dynamic business environment.
  • Excellent writing, editing, and storytelling skills, with the ability to tailor messages to different audiences.
  • Strong understanding of media relations, social media, content strategy, and digital communication trends.
  • Experience managing multiple projects simultaneously while maintaining attention to detail and quality.
  • Proficiency in creative and visual content tools such as Adobe Creative Cloud, Figma, or similar, with experience in video editing considered an advantage.
  • Strong stakeholder management and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across functions and cultures.
  • In-depth knowledge in communicating about technology, IT, and in particular atificial intelligence.
  • Fluent English communication skills; German language skills and experience in logistics or another global service industry are a plus.

What's in it for you

This is an opportunity to join a truly global organization where communications play a strategic role in driving business success. You will work closely with senior leaders, collaborate with international teams, and contribute to high-impact projects that influence employees, customers, media, and industry stakeholders worldwide. Based in Schindellegi, Switzerland, this role offers a dynamic environment where you can combine strategic thinking with hands-on execution while continuing to grow your communications expertise within a leading global logistics company.

Who we are

Logistics shapes everyday life - from the goods we consume to the healthcare we rely on. At Kuehne+Nagel, your work goes beyond logistics; it enables both ordinary and special moments in the lives of people around the world.

As a global leader with a strong heritage and a vision to move the world forward, we offer a safe, stable environment where your career can make a real difference. Whether we help deliver life-saving medicines, develop sustainable transportation solutions or support our local communities, your career will contribute to more than you can imagine.

  • Surveiller les tendances de l'industrie, appuyer les initiatives de gestion de la réputation et contribuer, au besoin, aux activités de communication en cas de crise.

Ce que nous aimerions que vous apportiez

  • 7-10 ans d'expérience dans les communications ministérielles, les relations publiques, les relations avec les médias ou un domaine connexe.
  • Expérience éprouvée dans la gestion des activités de communication interne et externe dans un environnement commercial dynamique.
  • Excellente capacité d'écriture, d'édition et de narration, avec la capacité d'adapter les messages à différents publics.
  • Une bonne compréhension des relations avec les médias, des médias sociaux, de la stratégie de contenu et des tendances en matière de communication numérique.
  • Expérience de gestion simultanée de plusieurs projets tout en maintenant l'attention aux détails et à la qualité.
  • Compétence en outils de contenu créatifs et visuels tels qu'Adobe Creative Cloud, Figma ou similaire, avec l'expérience de l'édition vidéo considérée comme un avantage.
  • Fortes compétences en gestion des intervenants et en collaboration, avec la capacité de travailler efficacement entre les fonctions et les cultures.
  • Connaissance approfondie de la communication sur la technologie, la TI et, en particulier, l'intelligence artificielle.
  • Les compétences de communication en anglais; les compétences et l'expérience linguistiques en allemand dans le domaine de la logistique ou dans une autre industrie mondiale de services sont un atout.

C'est l'occasion de rejoindre une organisation véritablement mondiale où les communications jouent un rôle stratégique dans la réussite des entreprises. Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec des cadres supérieurs, collaborerez avec des équipes internationales et contribuerez à des projets à impact élevé qui influencent les employés, les clients, les médias et les intervenants de l'industrie dans le monde entier. Basé à Schindellegi, en Suisse, ce rôle offre un environnement dynamique où vous pouvez combiner la pensée stratégique et l'exécution pratique tout en continuant à développer votre expertise en communication au sein d'une société de logistique mondiale de premier plan.

La logistique façonne la vie quotidienne - des biens que nous consommons aux soins de santé sur lesquels nous comptons. Chez Kuehne+ Nagel, votre travail va au-delà de la logistique; il permet à la fois des moments ordinaires et spéciaux dans la vie des gens à travers le monde.

En tant que leader mondial avec un patrimoine fort et une vision pour faire avancer le monde, nous offrons un environnement sûr et stable où votre carrière peut faire une vraie différence. Que nous aidions à fournir des médicaments qui sauvent la vie, à élaborer des solutions de transport durables ou à soutenir nos collectivités locales, votre carrière contribuera à plus que vous ne pouvez l'imaginer.

jobs.description:
It's more than a job

When you work in Freight Logistics and Operations at Kuehne+Nagel, you play a key role in optimising processes and ensuring that inventory and shipments move efficiently. But that is not all. Your work also helps ensure that vital medicines reach patients on time and supports other essential deliveries, from wind turbines to semiconductors. At Kuehne+Nagel, our contribution counts in more ways than we imagine.

‎
Join our Sea Logistics team as working student or graduate !

How you create impact

  • Support the accurate and timely processing of customer invoicing and revenue-related activities within Sea Logistics.
  • Review shipment files and financial data to ensure correct cost and revenue allocation.
  • Assist in identifying and resolving billing discrepancies in collaboration with operational teams, customers, and internal stakeholders.
  • Monitor revenue-related KPIs and contribute to maintaining data quality and financial accuracy.
  • Support month-end closing activities, reporting tasks, and revenue assurance processes.
  • Contribute to process improvement initiatives aimed at increasing efficiency, transparency, and profitability.

What we would like you to bring

  • Currently enrolled in a Bachelor's or Master's program, or recently graduated in Business Administration, Logistics, Supply Chain Management, Finance, or a related field.
  • Strong interest in logistics, transportation, finance, and commercial processes.
  • Good analytical skills with an affinity for working with numbers and data.
  • Proficiency in MS Office applications, particularly Excel; willingness to learn new systems and digital tools.
  • Detail-oriented, organized, and able to work accurately in a fast-paced environment.
  • Good communication skills and a proactive, solution-oriented mindset.
  • Fluent in English, both written and spoken; additional language skills in French, Italian or German are considered an advantage.

What's in it for you

  • Attractive compensation package
  • Modern office with excellent public transport connections and discounted parking
  • Diverse training and development opportunities within a global market leader
  • Numerous employee discounts in fashion, leisure, electronics, home & more
  • A supportive team environment with regular team and company events

Who we are

Logistics shapes everyday life - from the goods we consume to the healthcare we rely on. At Kuehne+Nagel, your work goes beyond logistics; it enables both ordinary and special moments in the lives of people around the world.

As a global leader with a strong heritage and a vision to move the world forward, we offer a safe, stable environment where your career can make a real difference. Whether we help deliver life-saving medicines, develop sustainable transportation solutions or support our local communities, your career will contribute to more than you can imagine.

We kindly advise that placement agencies refrain from submitting unsolicited profiles. Any submissions of candidates without prior signed agreement will be considered our property and no fees will be paid.

jobs.title: Senior Export Specialist (m/f/d) - Sea Logistics
jobs.description:
It's more than a job

As a member of the Freight Forwarding team Kuehne+Nagel, you will play a key role in transporting goods, optimising processes, and fulfilling our customers' promises. And by transporting medicines, toys and important machine parts, you are not only delivering goods, you are making small and big moments possible for people all around the world. At Kuehne+Nagel, our contribution counts in more ways than we imagine.

‎
Is international logistics your passion? In this role, you will coordinate global sea freight export shipments, collaborate closely with customers, shipping lines, and international partners, and ensure that goods reach their destination efficiently and reliably.

How you create impact

  • Operational responsibility for coordinating and handling international sea freight export shipments, including pre-carriage, main carriage, and port operations
  • Communication with shipping lines, overseas offices, and service providers regarding bookings, sailing schedules, cargo release, and export processing
  • Preparation and administration of export documentation and transport files in compliance with customer and regulatory requirements
  • Monitoring and optimization of export transport processes to ensure efficiency, profitability, and high data quality standards
  • Processing transport orders and resolving operational discrepancies in close cooperation with internal stakeholders and external partners
  • Tracking export shipments, ensuring fulfillment of customer KPIs, and maintaining sustainable customer and carrier relationships

What we would like you to bring

  • Completed training in freight forwarding and logistics or a comparable qualification
  • Professional experience in sea freight
  • Confident use of MS Office and openness to new technologies
  • Strong organizational skills, communication abilities, and solution‑oriented thinking
  • Fluent English skills, spoken and written, additional language skills in German, French, or Italian would be beneficial

What's in it for you

  • Attractive compensation package
  • Modern office with excellent public transport connections and discounted parking
  • Diverse training and development opportunities within a global market leader
  • Numerous employee discounts in fashion, leisure, electronics, home & more
  • A supportive team environment with regular team and company events

Who we are

Logistics shapes everyday life - from the goods we consume to the healthcare we rely on. At Kuehne+Nagel, your work goes beyond logistics; it enables both ordinary and special moments in the lives of people around the world.

As a global leader with a strong heritage and a vision to move the world forward, we offer a safe, stable environment where your career can make a real difference. Whether we help deliver life-saving medicines, develop sustainable transportation solutions or support our local communities, your career will contribute to more than you can imagine.

We kindly advise that placement agencies refrain from submitting unsolicited profiles. Any submissions of candidates without prior signed agreement will be considered our property and no fees will be paid.

It's more than a job

As a member of the Freight Forwarding team Kuehne+Nagel, you will play a key role in transporting goods, optimising processes, and fulfilling our customers' promises. And by transporting medicines, toys and important machine parts, you are not only delivering goods, you are making small and big moments possible for people all around the world. At Kuehne+Nagel, our contribution counts in more ways than we imagine.

‎
Is international logistics your passion? In this role, you will coordinate global sea freight export shipments, collaborate closely with customers, shipping lines, and international partners, and ensure that goods reach their destination efficiently and reliably.

How you create impact

  • Operational responsibility for coordinating and handling international sea freight export shipments, including pre-carriage, main carriage, and port operations
  • Communication with shipping lines, overseas offices, and service providers regarding bookings, sailing schedules, cargo release, and export processing
  • Preparation and administration of export documentation and transport files in compliance with customer and regulatory requirements
  • Monitoring and optimization of export transport processes to ensure efficiency, profitability, and high data quality standards
  • Processing transport orders and resolving operational discrepancies in close cooperation with internal stakeholders and external partners
  • Tracking export shipments, ensuring fulfillment of customer KPIs, and maintaining sustainable customer and carrier relationships

What we would like you to bring

  • Completed training in freight forwarding and logistics or a comparable qualification
  • Professional experience in sea freight
  • Confident use of MS Office and openness to new technologies
  • Strong organizational skills, communication abilities, and solution‑oriented thinking
  • Fluent English skills, spoken and written, additional language skills in German, French, or Italian would be beneficial

What's in it for you

  • Attractive compensation package
  • Modern office with excellent public transport connections and discounted parking
  • Diverse training and development opportunities within a global market leader
  • Numerous employee discounts in fashion, leisure, electronics, home & more
  • A supportive team environment with regular team and company events

Who we are

Logistics shapes everyday life - from the goods we consume to the healthcare we rely on. At Kuehne+Nagel, your work goes beyond logistics; it enables both ordinary and special moments in the lives of people around the world.

As a global leader with a strong heritage and a vision to move the world forward, we offer a safe, stable environment where your career can make a real difference. Whether we help deliver life-saving medicines, develop sustainable transportation solutions or support our local communities, your career will contribute to more than you can imagine.
